observations: Photo 0: silver and black retro-style mirrorless camera body; 'Nikon' on the prism housing and 'Z fc' on the top plate; Nikon 'Z mount' body cap fitted.
Photo 0: leather-textured front, grip and strap lug look clean with no visible dents or scratches.
Photo 1: top dials close up, ISO dial from 100 to 51200 with Hi settings, 'Z fc' on the top plate, a black manual lens fitted.
Photo 1: lens carries distance and depth-of-field scales and a 'TTArtisan' script mark, so it is a third-party manual focus lens, not a Nikon lens.
Photo 2: top view of the camera with shutter speed, exposure compensation and ISO dials, hot shoe and viewfinder eyecup.
Photo 2: accessories laid out: a Nikon rechargeable Li-ion battery, a Nikon battery charger, a Nikon body cap, a rear lens cap, and a front lens cap reading 'TTArtisan APS-C 25mm f2.0'.
No photo shows the rear screen, the camera switched on, the sensor, or a serial number.
All photos carry a marketplace and shop watermark.

identity.kind: mirrorless camera with a manual prime lens
identity.model: Z fc with TTArtisan 25mm f2 APS-C lens
read_from: photo 0 'Nikon' on prism and 'Z fc' on top plate

claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show 'Nikon' and 'Z fc' printed on the body.
Photo 0 and photo 2 show the SLR-style prism hump, analogue dials and a Z mount body cap.
Follows from the Z fc model read in photo 0; the sensor itself is not shown.

risks.risk: Camera does not power on or the shutter, autofocus or controls fail
risks.proof: Clip of the camera switching on, taking a shot and showing it on the rear screen

risks.risk: High shutter count or worn shutter
risks.proof: Shutter count screenshot from a recent image's metadata or a counter app

risks.risk: Rear flip-out screen cracked, scratched or the hinge broken
risks.proof: Photo of the rear screen opened out and lit up

risks.risk: Sensor scratched, dusty or with dead pixels
risks.proof: Photo of the sensor with the body cap off plus a sample shot of a plain bright wall
risks.if_unproven: as sensor needing cleaning or repair

risks.risk: Lens has fungus, haze or a stiff focus ring
risks.proof: Photo through the lens toward a light and a clip of the focus ring turning
risks.if_unproven: as body only, lens not counted

risks.risk: Camera is stolen or not the seller's to sell
risks.proof: Photo of the serial number under the base plate with a purchase receipt
risks.if_unproven: as no proof of ownership, flagged for agent check before payment

proof_requests: Clip of the camera powering on, taking a photo and playing it back on the rear screen
Photo of the rear screen opened out and the base plate serial number
Sample photo of a plain bright surface at a small aperture
Photo through the TTArtisan lens toward a light
response.reason: Photos 0 to 2 show a Nikon Z fc body with a TTArtisan 25mm f2 manual lens, battery and charger, so it can be priced at its worst case as untested with heavy use until a power-on clip and shutter count are sent.
